Troopers cannot end movement on top of walls. Troopers (and AT-RTs) can spend 2 actions to clamber over to the otherside.
Troopers roll 1 white defence die per mini for falling damage.

AT-STs treat this as difficult terrain.

Lock this for proper colliders
